description: This Java class 'JournalEntryReadPlatformServiceImpl' is an implementation of the 'JournalEntryReadPlatformService' interface. It provides methods to retrieve journal entry data from a database, including specific entries by ID, all entries with search options, office opening balances, and journal entries filtered by entity IDs. The class uses JDBC templates, data mappers, and auxiliary service dependencies to perform database operations and transform data into domain objects.

classes.name: GLJournalEntryMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL ResultSet rows to JournalEntryData objects, including detailed schema construction and mapping logic.

classes.name: JournalEntryReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the JournalEntryReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve journal entries and related data from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of journal entries based on search parameters and filtering criteria.

methods.name: retrieveGLJournalEntryById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific journal entry by its ID, with association parameters to control related data included.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeOpeningBalances
methods.description: Fetches office opening balance transactions, including balances for different account types and related process.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntriesByEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries associated with specific entity IDs and types, filtered by transaction ID.
